blocks.html: Operations that are causally related are seen by all clients in the same order, while unrelated operations may be seen in different orders.
blocks.text: Operations that are causally related are seen by all clients in the same order, while unrelated operations may be seen in different orders.

blocks.html: Guarantee:
blocks.text: Guarantee:

blocks.html: Preserves the “happens-before” relationship between operations.
blocks.text: Preserves the “happens-before” relationship between operations.

blocks.html: If operation A could have influenced operation B, all clients will see A before B.
blocks.text: If operation A could have influenced operation B, all clients will see A before B.

blocks.html: Operations that are independent may appear in different orders on different replicas.
blocks.text: Operations that are independent may appear in different orders on different replicas.

blocks.html: Pros:
blocks.text: Pros:

blocks.html: Provides a more intuitive ordering than eventual consistency.
blocks.text: Provides a more intuitive ordering than eventual consistency.

blocks.html: Avoids some anomalies while still allowing higher availability than strong consistency.
blocks.text: Avoids some anomalies while still allowing higher availability than strong consistency.

blocks.html: Cons/Anomalies:
blocks.text: Cons/Anomalies:

blocks.html: More complex than eventual consistency
blocks.text: More complex than eventual consistency

blocks.html: Still weaker than strong consistency
blocks.text: Still weaker than strong consistency

blocks.html: Concurrent Reordering: Independent (unrelated) operations may appear in different orders across replicas.
blocks.text: Concurrent Reordering: Independent (unrelated) operations may appear in different orders across replicas.

blocks.html: Non-Deterministic Views: Clients may disagree on the order of independent writes.
blocks.text: Non-Deterministic Views: Clients may disagree on the order of independent writes.
